quotes.text: "parallelAutoDiscovery should return null for an invalid email address"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The redirect test resumes discovery with acceptRedirect: false and expects a null configuration. Its assertion message says the email address is invalid, although the tested condition is refusal of a cross-domain HTTP redirect. The fixed accepted test retains this mismatch. A focused message correction should describe the rejected redirect and the expected null result. This finding concerns the assertion's explanation; it is not evidence of a discovery or network failure.
title: The redirect-rejection assertion describes an invalid email instead of the rejected redirect
